meta.title: Declare static method/property quickfix can add static member to interface
meta.fix_ref: microsoft/TypeScript#36854 (fix(29908): Declare static method/property quickfix can add static member to interface), bc12123115, 2020-02-18; git tag --contains: first in v3.9-beta / v3.9.2
meta.build_notes: npm typescript@3.8.3 (2020-02-28) and typescript@3.9.2 (2020-05-12), both behind typescript-language-server@0.4.0 (the latest wrapper release before 3.9.2), started with the pinned tsserver.js; the reported TypeScript version is checked on every session. Wrapper 0.4.0 is installed with the dependencies of its release date (install_builds.wrapper_before). The wrapper logs no TypeScript version; the build check verifies that its tsserver child runs the pinned tsserver.js.
meta.notes: A 'static' member in an interface is reported by the checker (TS1070), not by the parser, hence edit_leaves_diagnostic. The era wrapper returns quick fixes as bare commands (_typescript.applyWorkspaceEdit) without a code-action kind, so the edit spec selects by title only.

settings_note: The issue names no settings; no tsconfig.json, so tsserver uses an inferred project.

files.note: the file name is not given in the issue

repro.steps: Open index.ts: 'Foo.bard()' reports that bard does not exist on typeof Foo. Trigger the 'declare static method' quick fix on bard. Reported: 'static bard(): any;' is added to interface Foo (static is not allowed on a type member); expected: the method goes to the namespace, or no such fix is offered. Probe: after the fix, a fresh session on the edited file must neither report the targeted error on bard nor a new error. No offered action counts as absent.
